requirements_slice.system_goal: Reuse the existing compact Day/home DEV chip as a dev-only runtime diagnostics disclosure without changing DayBrief contracts, backend traffic, or production behavior.

in_scope.item: Keep the existing Day/home dev/prod chip visually compact.
In dev mode only on `/`, tapping the chip expands a lightweight local diagnostics block.
Show only render path, bootstrap result, and current mode from existing runtime/debug state.
Keep the diagnostics block local to the chip area with minimal layout shift.
Add targeted frontend verification and visual evidence for dev-expanded and prod-unchanged states.

out_of_scope.item: No new top-level debug banner or separate diagnostics screen.
No correlation, trace, or payload diagnostics in user-facing UI.
No changes to Week screen or other product surfaces.

use_case.summary: Inspect the active Day runtime lane from the existing compact chip without leaving the Day surface.
use_case.scenario: On `/` in non-production, tapping the compact chip expands a local disclosure with render path, bootstrap result, and runtime mode.
Tapping the chip again collapses the disclosure and restores the compact local state.
In production, the chip remains visually unchanged and inert and no diagnostics block appears.

business_invariants.invariant: The disclosure is client-local helper UI only and must not add backend requests or payload fields.
Only render path, bootstrap result, and current mode may appear in the visible disclosure body.
Production behavior remains inert and visually unchanged.
DayBrief hero, domains, CTA, scoring, and readiness semantics remain unchanged.
The disclosure must stay visually subordinate to the Day hero and must not become a banner.

expected_failure_handling.item: If any diagnostics source is absent, render a stable unknown or unavailable value instead of blocking the Day screen.
If the implementation causes a crash, hydration issue, or 500, add or update the smallest reproduction test before claiming green.
If the shell badge cannot be reused safely, escalate before widening behavior outside the Day route.
If the current route is not `/`, no new disclosure behavior should appear.

known_defects.defect: The chip is shell-owned and fixed-position in layout.tsx, so route-gating the interaction to `/` without leaking disclosure behavior into other routes remains the main implementation risk.
Production visual proof depends on a dedicated prod host or deterministic production-inert unit coverage because the active Playwright stack normally runs against the non-production frontend.

success_criteria.criterion: The Day chip stays compact in collapsed state.
In non-production on `/`, tapping the chip expands and collapses a local disclosure.
The disclosure shows render path, bootstrap result, and current mode only.
Production stays visually and behaviorally unchanged.
Verifier evidence includes dev-collapsed and dev-expanded screenshots plus an explicit Today observability verdict.
